common_gotchas: Carve profile curves are iso-parametric 2D profiles from the surface, not projected 3D curves.
When carving a trimmed surface, the resulting trim curves cannot be filleted or joined.
For faces, only points can be extracted and V parameters have no effect.
Breakpoint location mode changes which controls define extraction boundaries.
key_concepts: Carve SOP cuts or extracts geometry from polygon, Bezier, or NURBS faces and surfaces using parametric U/V domains.
Cut mode keeps selected surface sections, while extract mode can output isoparms, points, or profile curves.
Profile extraction creates iso-parametric 2D profiles from the surface rather than projected 3D curves.
Faces ignore V parameters for point extraction, while surfaces can use both U and V domains.
